userInputText: Astrodud.io is a free-to-play IO game that offers an exhilarating experience. Prepare yourself for the ultimate challenge of surviving an obstacle course on the internet. Lace up your sneakers and brace yourself for a fierce competition against thousands of players from across the globe. Your objective is to navigate the obstacle course, finish first, and stay alive. If you crave a fully immersive 3D arena atmosphere and a test of skill, dedication, and upgraded characters vying for the top spot, this is the game for you.
